character: Official historian, fondly unimpressed, no profanity, roast the action.

lines.subtitle: At last, our champion. The kingdom has chosen optimism.
lines.voiceScript: At last, our champion. [pause] The kingdom has chosen optimism.

lines.subtitle: Your legend begins now. The spelling remains under review.
lines.voiceScript: Your legend begins now. [pause] The spelling remains under review.

lines.subtitle: History awaits. I have brought an eraser.
lines.voiceScript: History awaits. [pause] I have brought an eraser.

lines.subtitle: A proper spell. I may yet keep my contract.
lines.voiceScript: A proper spell. I may yet keep my contract.

lines.subtitle: Correct, elegant, and deeply inconvenient to my material.
lines.voiceScript: Correct, elegant, and deeply inconvenient to my material.

lines.subtitle: Well cast. History may retain this paragraph.
lines.voiceScript: Well cast. History may retain this paragraph.

lines.subtitle: That was flawless. I shall deny saying so.
lines.voiceScript: That was flawless. [pause] I shall deny saying so.

lines.subtitle: The spell was ancient. Your spelling was experimental.
lines.voiceScript: The spell was ancient. [pause] Your spelling was… experimental.

lines.subtitle: Almost perfect. Magic, regrettably, is very specific.
lines.voiceScript: Almost perfect. [pause] Magic, regrettably, is very specific.

lines.subtitle: One letter wandered off. It has taken the battle with it.
lines.voiceScript: One letter wandered off. It has taken the battle with it.

lines.subtitle: Again? At this point, it may be tradition.
lines.voiceScript: [sigh] Again? [pause] At this point, it may be tradition.

lines.subtitle: The spellbook has begun taking this personally.
lines.voiceScript: The spellbook has begun taking this personally.

lines.subtitle: We have tested that spelling thoroughly. It remains unhelpful.
lines.voiceScript: We have tested that spelling thoroughly. It remains unhelpful.

lines.subtitle: You requested wind. The universe heard goose.
lines.voiceScript: You requested wind. [pause] The universe heard goose.

lines.subtitle: One vowel from glory. Several feathers from dignity.
lines.voiceScript: One vowel from glory. [pause] Several feathers from dignity.

lines.subtitle: Half a spell. All of the consequences.
lines.voiceScript: Half a spell. All of the consequences.

lines.subtitle: Competence has arrived. Fashionably late, but welcome.
lines.voiceScript: Competence has arrived. Fashionably late, but welcome.

lines.subtitle: You have prevailed. I shall revise my earlier notes.
lines.voiceScript: You have prevailed. [pause] I shall revise my earlier notes.

lines.subtitle: The kingdom is safe. The dictionary is pleasantly surprised.
lines.voiceScript: The kingdom is safe. The dictionary is pleasantly surprised.

lines.subtitle: A genuine triumph. How inconvenient for my closing joke.
lines.voiceScript: A genuine triumph. How inconvenient for my closing joke.

lines.subtitle: Here fell our hero: brave, bold, and one vowel short.
lines.voiceScript: Here fell our hero: brave, bold, and one vowel short.

lines.subtitle: The kingdom remains endangered. The dictionary feels vindicated.
lines.voiceScript: The kingdom remains endangered. The dictionary feels vindicated.

lines.subtitle: History shall remember this kindly. I shall not.
lines.voiceScript: History shall remember this kindly. [pause] I shall not.
